skill.name: gemini-image
skill.description: Generate and edit images with Gemini-style image models through a configured third-party API.
skill.summary: Creates text-to-image and image-to-image prompts for Gemini image generation workflows.
skill.author: Ceeon

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are Markdown formatting, placeholders, or installation examples rather than executable threats. Confirmed concerns remain for plaintext API key handling, bearer-token use with an external image API, and public image upload workflows that may expose user content. No prompt injection attempt or obfuscated payload was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: API key stored in a local skill file
remediation.suggestion: Use environment variables or a secret manager instead of a local Markdown secrets file, and document file permissions and gitignore requirements.

remediation.issue: Bearer token sent through a shell curl example
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a structured HTTP client or clearly warn users not to log commands, shell history, or generated requests containing tokens.

remediation.issue: Outbound requests to a third-party image API
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the exact provider, endpoint, data sent, and retention assumptions before users send prompts or image URLs.
Warn users not to upload private images, and recommend private storage or signed URLs for sensitive image-to-image workflows.

content.value_statement: Image generation workflows often need clear prompt formatting, model choices, and image reference handling. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through text-to-image and image-to-image requests using a configured API.
actual_capabilities: Guides text-to-image prompts for Gemini-style image generation models.
Supports image-to-image requests by placing image URLs before the prompt text.
Supports multiple reference image URLs for blended or comparative image generation.
Documents model choices for standard, 2K, and 4K image outputs.
Documents supported aspect ratios including square, landscape, portrait, and wide formats.
Provides guidance for editing Chinese text inside generated or referenced images.
limitations: Requires a separate API key from the configured third-party provider.
Image-to-image workflows require externally hosted image URLs.
Chinese text rendering may need repeated attempts and careful prompts.
The skill documents API calls but does not include a packaged client or validation layer.

use_cases.title: Create Concept Art
use_cases.description: Generate visual concepts from written scene descriptions, style notes, and aspect ratio requirements.

use_cases.title: Refine Reference Images
use_cases.description: Use hosted image URLs as references for enhancement, style transfer, or controlled visual edits.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Visuals
use_cases.description: Draft campaign images, social visuals, and product mockups with model and size guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Text Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an image of [subject] in [style]. Use a [aspect ratio] composition and include [important details].

prompt_templates.title: High Resolution Scene
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 4K image of [scene]. Use [lighting], [camera angle], and [mood]. Set the aspect ratio to [ratio].

prompt_templates.title: Reference Image Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: [image URL] Edit this image to [change]. Preserve [unchanged elements] and improve [specific quality].

prompt_templates.title: Multi Reference Blend
prompt_templates.prompt: [image URL 1] [image URL 2] Combine the first image's [element] with the second image's [style]. Keep the final result [constraints].

output_examples.input: Generate a square image of a warm desk setup with a notebook, plants, and morning light.
output_examples.output: A generated image URL for a square desk scene, with warm lighting and the requested objects represented.

output_examples.input: Use an uploaded product photo URL and create a clean 16:9 hero image for a launch announcement.
output_examples.output: A generated image URL for a wide promotional visual based on the provided product reference.

output_examples.input: Edit a referenced poster image so one Chinese character changes while the rest stays unchanged.
output_examples.output: A generated image URL plus guidance to inspect the text result and retry if the character is inaccurate.

best_practices: Use precise subject, style, composition, lighting, and aspect ratio details in every prompt.
Use temporary or private image hosting for references that contain sensitive content.
Inspect generated text carefully, especially for Chinese characters or small typography.
anti_patterns: Do not upload confidential, personal, or regulated images to public image hosts.
Do not place real API keys in shared repositories, transcripts, screenshots, or support tickets.
Do not ask for many unrelated visual edits in one prompt when one focused edit is safer.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images directly?
faq.answer: It guides the agent to call a configured third-party image API and return the generated image URL.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it support image-to-image generation?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill uses one or more image URLs before the prompt text as image references.

faq.question: Is an API key required?
faq.answer: Yes. Users must configure an API key for the provider before making image generation requests.

faq.question: Can it create images with Chinese text?
faq.answer: It includes Chinese text prompting tips, but generated text may require retries and careful review.

faq.question: What privacy precautions are important?
faq.answer: Avoid public image hosts for sensitive images, and understand that prompts and image URLs are sent to external services.
